plainText:
Volume 10 is the tenth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto. 

==Blurb==
In order to assist Professor Oak's research, a young Trainer, Crystal, hits the streets of Cherrygrove City with a new Pokédex in hand! Her goal is to catch all kinds of Pokémon! And what will happen when the Legendary Pokémon Suicune has awakened?

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 117 - Slugging It Out with Slugma
Chapter 118 - Three Cheers for Chikorita
Chapter 119 - A Flaaffy Kerfuffle
Chapter 120 - Surrounded by Staryu
Chapter 121 - Off Course with Corsola
Chapter 122 - Querulous Qwilfish
Chapter 123 - Debonaire Dragonair
Chapter 124 - Scrappy Skarmory
Chapter 125 - Misdreavus Misgivings
Chapter 126 - Jumping Jumpluff!
Chapter 127 - Miltank Melee
Chapter 128 - Indubitably Ditto
Chapter 129 - Great Girafarig

==Important events==
 
receives a Pokédex and begins her Pokémon journey.
Crystal encounters , and later the Suicune-obsessed Mysticalman Eusine.
Eusine snags the Clear Bells from three s.
Crystal reaches the Burned Tower.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Crystal's , "Megaree" in PS118.

==Character summary==
This is Crystal's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.
===Crystal's Pokédex===
Gym Badges: 0
Pokémon seen: 143
Pokémon owned: 142

==Trivia==
Satoshi Yamamoto takes over as the artist for Pokémon Adventures in this volume, replacing Mato, who had to quit due to an illness which left her hand weak and unable to draw.

==Errors==
===VIZ Media translation===
In one panel Crystal's Megaree is mistakenly referred to as "Mega", which is ironically its Chuang Yi nickname.
On page 65, Crystal called Fast Balls "Speed Balls", their Japanese name. (Ironically Chuang Yi's translation also made exactly the same error)
On page 101, Ryu mistakenly refers to Lance as Clair's brother, instead of cousin.
On page 153 Crystal mistakenly refers to an "Electric Attack" as a "Shock Attack".

===Chuang Yi translation===
Chuang Yi's translation also makes the mistake of calling Fast Balls "Speed Balls", their Japanese name.
